method: docker image inspect -f '{{.Size}}' on images built in WSL Ubuntu-24.04 Docker

current.description: docker/production/Dockerfile --target api, PyTorch CPU, as shipped

current_with_onnxruntime.description: the current image plus onnxruntime==1.29.0, as needed to serve DFU_INFERENCE_ENGINE=onnx

without_torch.description: python:3.12-slim with requirements.txt minus torch, torchvision, pytest and setuptools, plus onnxruntime==1.29.0
without_torch.why_not: src/inference/engine.py, preprocessing and src/api/service.py import torch, and the entrypoint fetches only the .pth checkpoint

finding: Adding ONNX serving to the current image makes it about 97 MB larger. Dropping torch would cut the image to about 45 % of its size, but needs torch-free preprocessing and an entrypoint that fetches the ONNX file.
